properties.query:
// Files Filewall blocked as malicious or suspicious in the last 14 days, keyed by original hash,
// matched by SHA1 or SHA256 with device file events seen after Filewall recorded the file.
// A pair alerts on the run after its later side is ingested, so late Filewall records still match.
let lookback = 14d;
let ingestWindow = 1h;
let FilewallBlocked = materialize(union
    (FilewallM365EmailAttachmentEvent()
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where ThreatVerdict in ("Malicious", "Suspicious")
    | project FilewallTime = TimeGenerated, FilewallIngested = IngestionTime, OriginalSHA256 = OriginalFileSha256, OriginalSHA1 = OriginalFileSha1, SanitizedSHA256 = SanitizedFileSha256, ThreatVerdict, EventSeverity, FilewallFileName = AttachmentName, FilewallUser = EmailRecipientTo, FilewallSource = "exchange", BlockReason = AttachmentBlockReason, EventReportUrl),
    (FilewallM365FileEvent()
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where ThreatVerdict in ("Malicious", "Suspicious")
    | project FilewallTime = TimeGenerated, FilewallIngested = IngestionTime, OriginalSHA256 = OriginalFileSha256, OriginalSHA1 = OriginalFileSha1, SanitizedSHA256 = SanitizedFileSha256, ThreatVerdict, EventSeverity, FilewallFileName = TargetFileName, FilewallUser = ActorUsername, FilewallSource = TargetFilePathType, BlockReason = block_reason, EventReportUrl)
  | where isnotempty(OriginalSHA256) or isnotempty(OriginalSHA1)
  // first Filewall record per file, so a repeat block of a known file does not re-alert old sightings
  | summarize arg_min(FilewallTime, *) by OriginalSHA256, OriginalSHA1);
let Sha256Set = FilewallBlocked | where isnotempty(OriginalSHA256) | distinct OriginalSHA256;
let Sha1Set = FilewallBlocked | where isnotempty(OriginalSHA1) | distinct OriginalSHA1;
let DeviceSeen = materialize(DeviceFileEvents
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
  | extend DeviceIngested = ingestion_time(), SHA1 = tolower(SHA1), SHA256 = tolower(SHA256)
  | where SHA256 in (Sha256Set) or SHA1 in (Sha1Set)
  | project TimeGenerated, DeviceIngested, DeviceId, DeviceName, ActionType, FileName, FolderPath, SHA1, SHA256, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessAccountUpn, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessAccountDomain);
union
    (DeviceSeen | where isnotempty(SHA256) | join kind=inner (FilewallBlocked | where isnotempty(OriginalSHA256)) on $left.SHA256 == $right.OriginalSHA256),
    (DeviceSeen | where isnotempty(SHA1) | join kind=inner (FilewallBlocked | where isnotempty(OriginalSHA1)) on $left.SHA1 == $right.OriginalSHA1)
| where TimeGenerated > FilewallTime
| where DeviceIngested > ago(ingestWindow) or FilewallIngested > ago(ingestWindow)
| summarize arg_min(TimeGenerated, *) by OriginalSHA256, OriginalSHA1, DeviceId
| extend DeviceAccountUpn = tostring(InitiatingProcessAccountUpn)
| extend
    DeviceAccountName = iff(isnotempty(DeviceAccountUpn), tostring(split(DeviceAccountUpn, "@")[0]), InitiatingProcessAccountName),
    DeviceAccountUPNSuffix = iff(isnotempty(DeviceAccountUpn), tostring(split(DeviceAccountUpn, "@")[1]), ""),
    DeviceAccountNTDomain = iff(isempty(DeviceAccountUpn), InitiatingProcessAccountDomain, ""),
    FilewallAccountName = tostring(split(FilewallUser, "@")[0]),
    FilewallUPNSuffix = tostring(split(FilewallUser, "@")[1]),
    FileDirectory = iff(FolderPath endswith FileName, substring(FolderPath, 0, strlen(FolderPath) - strlen(FileName) - 1), FolderPath),
    // the hashes Filewall recorded for the original file, mapped as two FileHash entities
    SHA256 = OriginalSHA256,
    SHA1 = OriginalSHA1,
    Sha256Algorithm = iff(isnotempty(OriginalSHA256), "SHA256", ""),
    Sha1Algorithm = iff(isnotempty(OriginalSHA1), "SHA1", "")
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceId, DeviceName, ActionType, FileName, FileDirectory, FolderPath, SHA256, Sha256Algorithm, SHA1, Sha1Algorithm, SanitizedSHA256, InitiatingProcessFileName, DeviceAccountName, DeviceAccountUPNSuffix, DeviceAccountNTDomain, ThreatVerdict, EventSeverity, BlockReason, FilewallTime, FilewallFileName, FilewallUser, FilewallAccountName, FilewallUPNSuffix, FilewallSource, EventReportUrl
properties.description:
'Correlates files that Filewall for Microsoft 365 blocked as malicious or suspicious, in email attachments or in SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams, with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint file events.
A match means the original file was seen on a device after Filewall recorded it (when the email was received, or when the file was processed), so it reached the device by another path, for example a direct download, a removable drive, another mail flow or a copy released from quarantine.
The match is on the original file hash Filewall recorded, by SHA1 (always set in DeviceFileEvents) or SHA256; the sanitized hash is kept in the custom details. Each run alerts on pairs where either side was ingested in the last hour, so a match is found whichever record arrives last. Requires the Microsoft Defender XDR connector to stream DeviceFileEvents into the workspace.'

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Filewall for Microsoft 365 blocked this file as {{ThreatVerdict}} ({{BlockReason}}), and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint later recorded the original file on {{DeviceName}}, so it reached the device by another path; the alert link opens the blocked item in the Filewall console.
alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: File Filewall blocked as {{ThreatVerdict}} seen on {{DeviceName}}

properties.name: Filewall - File Filewall blocked as malicious or suspicious seen on a device
